controls.title: Audit controls
controls.requirement: Record and examine activity in systems that contain or use ePHI.
controls.detail: 27 passed, 0 failed; audit_log carries who/what/outcome/source: true

controls.title: Integrity
controls.requirement: Protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction.

controls.title: Mechanism to authenticate ePHI
controls.requirement: Corroborate that ePHI has not been altered or destroyed.
controls.detail: update refused: true; delete refused: true; service_role holds INSERT,SELECT

controls.title: Person or entity authentication
controls.requirement: Verify that a person seeking access is the one claimed.

controls.title: Transmission security
controls.requirement: Guard against unauthorised access to ePHI in transit.

controls.title: Information access management
controls.requirement: Authorise access to ePHI only as appropriate, minimum necessary.

controls.title: Encryption and decryption
controls.requirement: Encrypt and decrypt ePHI, including credentials at rest.
controls.detail: 19 passed, 0 failed; api keys stored as sha256: true

controls.title: Minimum necessary, recordings and logs
controls.requirement: Limit PHI in what is stored to the minimum necessary.
controls.detail: redaction exists in 14 files but targets secrets and placeholders, not PHI

controls.title: Business associate contracts
controls.requirement: A BAA with every subprocessor that handles ePHI.
controls.detail: no BAA with Google Cloud; no BAA with Supabase; no BAA with Model provider (OpenAI, Anthropic or Vertex AI)

controls.title: Documentation retention
controls.requirement: Retain required documentation for six years.
controls.detail: default audit retention floor is 365 days; six years is 2190
